metric_defs.prefill20k: P1: single request, 20000 exact unique input_ids, n_predict=1 -> server-native prompt_per_second (tok/s)
metric_defs.decode1k_code: D1 CODE: single ~1000-token decode (n_predict=1000, ignore_eos) -> native predicted_per_second (tok/s)
metric_defs.decode1k_prose: D1 PROSE: single ~1000-token decode (n_predict=1000, ignore_eos) -> native predicted_per_second (tok/s)
metric_defs.par8_prefill: P8: 8 parallel requests x 6000 exact input_ids, n_predict=1 -> total_prompt_tokens / wall (aggregate tok/s)
metric_defs.par8_decode_code: D8 CODE: 8 parallel x ~400-token decode -> total_completion_tokens / wall (aggregate tok/s)
metric_defs.par8_decode_prose: D8 PROSE: 8 parallel x ~400-token decode -> aggregate tok/s
metric_defs.maxKV_tokens: largest bootable+serving -c (total context) via cooldown-gated bisection; llama.cpp analog of sglang max_total_num_tokens

global_caveats: q8_0 KV CAVEAT: llama.cpp has NO fp8 KV cache. All cells use 8-bit BLOCK-quant KV (-ctk/-ctv q8_0, +draft -ctkd/-ctvd q8_0, -fa on) as the closest analog to the other engines' --kv-cache-dtype fp8. q8_0 (block-quant) != fp8 (per-tensor).

MTP/spec ACTIVE on every decode: --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3 (embedded MTP draft). llama.cpp /completion does NOT expose the spec acceptance length, so D1/D8 accept = null; the decode tok/s already reflect the MTP speedup.

UNCACHED verified by construction: cache_prompt:false + unique per-request input_ids (random nonce/salt) + prompt_tokens ALWAYS == requested count (every token evaluated, no prefix reuse). NOTE the harness field 'uncached_ok' reports FALSE for llama.cpp because llama.cpp's response 'tokens_cached' = tokens resident in KV AFTER the prefill (not cross-request prefix-cache hits); it is a benign field-semantics mismatch, not real caching.

prefill/decode tok/s are server-native (timings.*_per_second), excluding HTTP roundtrip; single warmed sample per boot (bench_measure.py runs one warmed battery per invocation; it has no built-in median-of-3 loop). maxKV IS a bisection.

HARNESS FIXES applied (M27a, documented): (1) llamacpp_run.sh MODELPATH pointed at the VM-side GGUF dir (which ships a valid HF tokenizer) instead of the host mount path, so bench_measure's exact-length prefill tokenizer loads; (2) bench_measure.py llamacpp adapter now sends ignore_eos:true so decode length is deterministic (a prose decode had stopped at 4 tokens).

q6_tp2_tensor.split: -sm tensor across the two RTX3080s (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2). This is REAL tensor parallelism (splits weights AND KV, NCCL allreduce), the intended '2-card TP=2' cell. Replaces the originally-planned '-sm row' which is INFEASIBLE here (see notes).
q6_tp2_tensor.maxKV_detail: 266856 boots+serves; 271068 OOMs (memory-bound, real; only 2x20GB=40GB). Verified OOM at 393216 with nvidia-smi.

startup_args.docker_run: docker run -d --name llbench --gpus all --ipc=host --shm-size=4g --security-opt apparmor=unconfined -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2 -e NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 -e NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0 -e NCCL_DEBUG=WARN -v <models-cache>:/models:ro -p 8020:8080 ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda
startup_args.server_common: --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 -m /models/unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-MTP-GGUF/Qwen3.6-27B-UD-Q6_K_XL.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -ctkd q8_0 -ctvd q8_0 --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3 --jinja -sm tensor
startup_args.NCCL_DOCKER_REQUIREMENT: -sm tensor does cross-GPU allreduce over NCCL. Default docker (64MB /dev/shm, no IPC ns) makes NCCL abort with 'unhandled system error' at ncclGroupEnd(). REQUIRED: --ipc=host --shm-size=4g + NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 (no P2P on these GeForce cards) + NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0. With these it boots and serves.

notes: ORIGINAL '-sm row' cell is INFEASIBLE on this hardware: fails at model load with 'device CUDA0 does not support split buffers' — row-split needs GPU split-buffer/P2P support, and nvidia-smi -p2p r shows NS/CNS for ALL GPU pairs (PHB-only PCIe, no NVLink; GeForce P2P disabled). Switched to -sm tensor, the genuine TP mode, per user direction.
-sm tensor logs 'backend sampling not supported with SPLIT_MODE_TENSOR; using CPU' -> sampling runs on CPU in tensor mode (a llama.cpp limitation, not an error).
'llama_params_fit is not implemented for SPLIT_MODE_TENSOR' -> auto-fit disabled; -c is taken as requested (relevant for maxKV).

Prefill (P1 1089.8, P8 991.2) is LOWER than 3-GPU layer-split: NCCL allreduce over SHM transport (no P2P) adds cross-GPU sync cost per layer. Single-stream DECODE (79.6 code) is FASTER than layer-split (74.5) because tensor-parallel splits the decode compute across both GPUs instead of pipelining.
q8_0 block-quant KV; MTP draft active; accept-length not exposed.
